question: In the Belgium Jupiler League during April 2009, find the away team that won the most matches. Then, among all players taller than 180 cm, compute the average of their heading accuracy values recorded in 2014. Return the team name and this average heading accuracy.

prediction.sql:
WITH top_away_team AS (
    SELECT T.XCL_173 AS team_name
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    INNER JOIN Team T ON M.XCL_014 = T.XCL_171
    WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
      AND M.XCL_011 LIKE '2009-04%'
      AND M.XCL_016 > M.XCL_015
    GROUP BY T.XCL_173
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT AVG(PA.XCL_139) AS avg_heading
    FROM Player P
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
    WHERE P.XCL_126 > 180
      AND PA.XCL_131 LIKE '2014%'
)
SELECT tat.team_name, ah.avg_heading
FROM top_away_team tat
CROSS JOIN avg_heading ah

WITH top_away_team AS (
    SELECT T.XCL_173 AS team_name
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    INNER JOIN Team T ON M.XCL_014 = T.XCL_171
    WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
      AND M.XCL_011 LIKE '2009-04%'
      AND M.XCL_016 > M.XCL_015
    GROUP BY T.XCL_173
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT AVG(PA.XCL_139) AS avg_heading
    FROM Player P
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
    WHERE P.XCL_126 > 180
      AND PA.XCL_131 LIKE '2014%'
)
SELECT tat.team_name, ah.avg_heading
FROM top_away_team tat
CROSS JOIN avg_heading ah

WITH top_away_team AS (
    SELECT T.XCL_173 AS team_name
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    INNER JOIN Team T ON M.XCL_014 = T.XCL_171
    WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
      AND M.XCL_011 LIKE '2009-04%'
      AND M.XCL_016 > M.XCL_015
    GROUP BY T.XCL_173
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT AVG(PA.XCL_139) AS avg_heading
    FROM Player P
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
    WHERE P.XCL_126 > 180
      AND PA.XCL_131 LIKE '2014%'
)
SELECT tat.team_name, ah.avg_heading
FROM top_away_team tat
CROSS JOIN avg_heading ah

WITH top_away_team AS (
    SELECT T.XCL_173 AS team_name
    FROM League L
    INNER JOIN Match M ON L.XCL_003 = M.XCL_008
    INNER JOIN Team T ON M.XCL_014 = T.XCL_171
    WHERE L.XCL_005 = 'Belgium Jupiler League'
      AND M.XCL_011 LIKE '2009-04%'
      AND M.XCL_017 > M.XCL_016
    GROUP BY T.XCL_173
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT AVG(PA.XCL_138) AS avg_heading
    FROM Player P
    INNER JOIN Player_Attributes PA ON P.XCL_122 = PA.XCL_130
    WHERE P.XCL_126 > 180
      AND PA.XCL_129 LIKE '2014%'
)
SELECT tat.team_name, ah.avg_heading
FROM top_away_team tat
CROSS JOIN avg_heading ah

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
WITH away_wins AS (
    SELECT 
        t.XCL_173 AS team_name,
        COUNT(*) AS wins
    FROM "Match" m
    JOIN "Team" t ON m.XCL_014 = t.XCL_171
    JOIN "League" l ON m.XCL_007 = l.XCL_003
    JOIN "Country" c ON l.XCL_004 = c.XCL_001
    WHERE c.XCL_002 = 'Belgium'
      AND l.XCL_005 = 'Jupiler League'
      AND m.XCL_009 LIKE '2009-04%'
      AND m.XCL_010 > m.XCL_012
    GROUP BY t.XCL_173
    ORDER BY wins DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
avg_heading AS (
    SELECT 
        AVG(pa.XCL_137) AS avg_heading_accuracy
    FROM "Player_Attributes" pa
    JOIN "Player" p ON pa.XCL_130 = p.XCL_122
    WHERE p.XCL_126 > 180
      AND pa.XCL_131 LIKE '2014%'
)
SELECT 
    aw.team_name,
    ah.avg_heading_accuracy
FROM away_wins aw
CROSS JOIN avg_heading ah
